items.guidance: This is a Go server on port 7080, so search the Go HTTP router setup, not Express code, for an existing route such as healthz or a build-info route that answers without a session. If you must add one, mount it on the root router before the authentication and redirect middleware, and return 200 from a plain handler without database access.

Search the Go code for embedded SQL migration files and the function that applies them, and check whether the server calls it during startup. If it does, report that file and change nothing. If migrations run only through a separate subcommand of the server binary, report that exact subcommand as the release migration command.

Check whether the dogfood Terraform files are only templates or environments the maintainers use for their own installation, which the server never reads at runtime. Separately check whether the application itself runs Terraform as part of its product features, because that means the app manages infrastructure. Report both findings.
